name: openinglab
description: A free, private, offline-capable chess opening trainer.

scripts.quality: npm run check:syntax && npm run lint && npm run check:version && npm run validate:curriculum && npm run curriculum:report && npm run test:unit && npm run check:static && npm run sw:check
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/flows.spec.js tests/e2e/pwa.spec.js
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.js
scripts.validate: npm run quality && npm run build && npm run check:performance && playwright test
